title: L-system tree builder with a 3D turtle
purpose: Grow trees and plants for three.js from L-system grammars: rewrite with deterministic or seeded stochastic rules, walk the string with a 3D turtle (turn, pitch, roll, branch, taper) and build tapered branch cylinders in one mesh, with leaf anchors for instanced foliage. Use it for forests, bushes, coral and vines.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: rewriteLSystem, interpretTurtle and lsystemTreeData need no three.js; createLsystemTreeGeometry takes three.js as THREE; only 0.186.1 was run.

exports.name: rewriteLSystem
exports.signature: rewriteLSystem(axiom, rules, iterations, seed = 1, maxLength = 1000000) -> string
exports.summary: Parallel rewriting; a rule is a successor string or {successor, weight} choices picked by the seeded generator.

exports.name: interpretTurtle
exports.summary: 3D turtle walk: segments {start, end, startRadius, endRadius, left, up} and leaves {position, heading}.

exports.name: lsystemTreeData
exports.signature: lsystemTreeData(commands, options = {}) -> {positions, normals, uvs, indices, segmentCount, leafPositions, leafDirections}
exports.summary: One open tapered cylinder per F, merged into typed arrays, with leaf anchors.

exports.name: createLsystemTreeGeometry
exports.summary: The branches in a BufferGeometry; leaf anchors in userData.leafPositions and userData.leafDirections.

exports.name: LSYSTEM_TREE_DEFAULTS
exports.summary: Frozen default turtle and mesh options.

options.name: lengthScale
options.meaning: Step multiplier for the double quote command.

options.name: segmentTaper
options.meaning: Radius multiplier along every F, so branches narrow as they grow.

options.name: maxSegments
options.meaning: Refuse strings that would draw more branches than this.

limits: Context-free, non-parametric L-systems only: no context-sensitive or parametric rules, tropism, collision or self-shadowing pruning. Each F is a separate open cylinder; joints overlap instead of welding, branch ends are open, and very thin branches stay as many small cylinders (instance or merge them for large forests). Leaves are anchor points with a heading; drawing them is up to you. Strings grow exponentially; maxLength and maxSegments refuse runaway grammars. Rotation errors accumulate in very long walks. Only three.js 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: 3D turtle interpretation with heading, left and up vectors (Prusinkiewicz and Lindenmayer)
Weighted stochastic productions with a seeded Weyl-sequence generator
